text_block_list.text:
“—Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival.
It's a major social event where fans are welcomed into Tracen Academy, with the lively atmosphere of a sports festival.”
As for Katsuragi Ace—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The "Explosive Friendship Three-Legged Obstacle Race"!
A star-studded lineup of pairs has gathered once again this year!!
Which duo will seize the glory~?!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text: CB, do your best~~!!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text: Don't push yourself too hard~~!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: To think that even in a random lottery draw, I'd end up paired with C.B....

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ehh, is there something wrong with going with me?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Because you'd definitely suck at a three-legged race!
You're not the type to match pace with others at all!!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha, true enough.
Then how about Ace matches my pace instead?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you sure make it sound easy.
...Well, not like I can't do it, though.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
......Just to be sure,
is your leg really okay?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
As long as it's not a race, I'm fine.
Right now it's more about my hoof than my leg anyway.
Well, don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, let's go for the win!
When I do stuff like this,
I take it dead serious!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Same here.
Since I went through the trouble of teaming up with Ace, winning sounds a whole lot more fun."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, we are just moments away from the start!
Are all groups ready!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —For now, I'm gonna do whatever I want.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead. Cowering in your shell
doesn't suit you at all.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now then, on your marks—
Get seeeeeet, GO!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, looks like one pair got off to an explosive start already!?
It's Mr. C.B. and Katsuragi Ace!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Katsuragi Ace, who's with CB—she's a classmate from her generation who's raced against her countless times, right? They're totally in sync...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I mean, isn't that group way too fast...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're amazing, Ace!
It makes it so much easier to run!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Well, thanks a lot!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, having reached the first prompt zone
are our leaders, C.B. & Ace!
Their bond as a tag team will be put to the test!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, let's see.
"Take a friendly selfie together with this smartphone," huh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's hurry up and take it!
Get closer, get closer!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Say cheese. Yay.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Let's see, the next prompt is:
"Say this tongue twister together," huh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is crazy hard!?
Think you can do it, C.B.?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Tokkyo Kyokakyokuchou Kyou Kyuukyo Kyuuka Kyoka Kyohi!
All right, nailed it. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "We're saying it at the exact same time! That's crazy, though!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oh! They even have the leeway to pull off an impromptu comedy routine?!
CB and Ace show off overwhelming teamwork!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, absolutely phenomenal, CB and Ace!
Clearing each challenge one after another with blinding speed—
and dashing across the finish liiiine in the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright!!
You did it, CB!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that was fun.

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Cee Bee~~~~~!!!!!
Congraaaats on winningーーーー!!!"

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"That was super fun!!!
Good luck in your race too!!"
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Haha, what incredible cheering...!
Even though she's on break, CB's popularity is truly something else...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Next up is a commemorative photo shoot with the winning duo!
To all the fans, please come up close
and snap some memorable photos with the two champions~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"—Say what you will, but won't most of them
just be coming for C.B.?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "No, no, that can't be right. Look—"

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Katsuragi Ace-san!
Could I get a picture with you, please??

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, yeah.
Sure, I'm down, but...—

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yay...! Um, I'm always cheering for you!
You looked so cool at the Osaka Hai the other day too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
For real?!
Whoa, I'm legitimately super happy...!
Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Um, if it's okay, I'd like to, too...!
I've been watching the races lately...!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan C
text_block_list.text: Ah, me too!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Right? Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

—And on the night of the day
the Fan Thanksgiving Festival successfully came to a close...

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Katsuragi Ace-san!
Could I get a picture with you, please??

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, yeah.
Sure, I'm down, but...—

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yay...! Um, I'm always cheering for you!
You looked so cool at the Osaka Hai the other day too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
For real?!
Whoa, I'm legitimately super happy...!
Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace-san!!
Could you sign over here too?! My daughter's a huge fan...!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan C
text_block_list.text: Ah, me too!! Please, count me in!!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fans
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Th-This much...?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Right? Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Both of Their Fans
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! I-If it's alright with you...
Could I take a photo of the two of you together?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh, not with big sis, 
but with ours?

text_block_list.name: Both of Their Fans
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That team play just now was amazing!
We've definitely gotta do that again...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I mean, right?
Should we make a heart shape next?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on, ain't that kinda embarrassing...?

text_block_list.name: Both of Their Fans
text_block_list.text:
No!!!
Yes, please, let's do that!!!!!

—And on the night of the day
the Fan Thanksgiving Festival successfully came to a close...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Still, I was really surprised.
Turns out I have more fans than I thought.
choice_data_list: Looks like they've really been increasing in number lately.
Looks like they've really been increasing in number lately.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!?
Aw man, I had no idea...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it,
I was only ever thinking about myself when I ran."
choice_data_list: Everyone draws courage from your running.
Everyone draws courage from your running.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...If that's the case, I'd be so happy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
For the Takarazuka Kinen, I've got to
run a race worthy of everyone cheering me on!

For Katsuragi Ace, it turned out to be a Fan Thanks Day
that fired her up anew...
